findings.title: Unrestricted cook_method allows raw HTML injection
findings.body: lib/post_creator.rb:216 copies opts[:cook_method] onto the post without any permission check. Combined with Post#cook returning raw un-sanitized HTML when cook_method is raw_html, any caller that can reach PostCreator with user-controlled opts can create a post that bypasses Markdown cooking and HTML sanitization, resulting in persistent stored XSS executed for all viewers of the topic.

findings.title: raw_html cook mode returns unsanitized raw
findings.body: app/models/post.rb:133 returns raw directly when cook_method is raw_html, skipping PrettyText cooking, sanitization and Plugin::Filter. TopicEmbed.import uses this mode for untrusted RSS/Readability HTML and embed views render it with raw post.cooked, so an attacker controlling a feed or embedded page can inject script, iframe, javascript: URLs and event handlers that execute in Discourse and embed contexts.

findings.title: Embed import stores unsanitized external HTML and mutates input
findings.body: app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 appends an imported_from footer via contents <<, mutating the caller's string so reusing the same object appends multiple footers and changes SHA on every call, and interpolates url directly into <a href='...'> without escaping. The resulting string is absolutized only for leading-slash href/src and stored as raw_html with no sanitization of script tags, javascript: URLs or event attributes, giving stored XSS from RSS/remote content.

findings.title: Referer injected into JS and used as postMessage targetOrigin
findings.body: app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:11 embeds request.referer, which is attacker-controlled HTTP header data, directly into a script as parent.postMessage(..., '<%= request.referer %>'). postMessage requires an origin (scheme+host+port), not a full URL with path/query, so this throws or mis-delivers the resize message. It also relies on HTML-escaping inside raw script text, which is the wrong context for JS string encoding.

findings.title: postMessage origin check uses reversed substring test
findings.body: app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:17 tests discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1 instead of comparing origins for equality. This accepts any e.origin that happens to be a substring of discourseUrl (for example empty string) and rejects valid cases where formatting differs (trailing slash, port). An attacker frame can then drive iframe resizing or future message handling.

findings.title: open(feed_url) allows command execution and SSRF
findings.body: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 calls open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) via Kernel#open/open-uri with no validation, timeout, size limit or redirect control. A value starting with | executes a shell command in Ruby, and any http URL causes server-side request forgery to internal hosts, with the job hanging on slow remotes.

findings.title: Feed item with missing content crashes entire poll
findings.body: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 does CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) assuming every RSS/Atom item has non-nil content. Items with only description/summary or nil content raise NoMethodError, aborting the loop so no later items are imported and the hourly job fails.

findings.title: import_remote fetches arbitrary URL without safeguards
findings.body: app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 does open(url).read without requiring open-uri in this file, without timeout, size limit, redirect/host allowlist or rescue. It enables SSRF to internal services, memory exhaustion on large pages, unhandled network/Readability exceptions that fail RetrieveTopic jobs, and on hosts without open-uri loaded it tries to open a local file path instead of HTTP.

findings.title: Incorrect success check and race on unique embed_url
findings.body: app/models/topic_embed.rb:24 tests if post.present? after PostCreator, but PostCreator returns an unsaved post object with errors on failure, so TopicEmbed.create! can run with nil topic_id/post_id. Concurrent imports for the same URL both see embed.blank? and both create topics, then the second unique index on embed_url raises RecordNotUnique with no handling, leaving duplicate topics.

findings.title: Non-atomic throttle leaves permanent Redis key
findings.body: lib/topic_retriever.rb:27-28 uses $redis.setnx followed by separate $redis.expire to throttle to once per 60s. If the process crashes between the two calls the key never expires and that embed_url is throttled forever. The key also embeds the raw user-controlled URL with no normalization or length bound, allowing Redis bloat by requesting many unique URLs.

findings.title: Missing embed_by_username crashes retriever
findings.body: lib/topic_retriever.rb:49 calls SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase without checking presence. If the admin has not configured embed_by_username, this raises NoMethodError on nil, failing every RetrieveTopic job instead of bailing out cleanly as PollFeed does.

findings.title: Spec expects TopicRetriever but controller enqueues job
findings.body: spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43 expects TopicRetriever.new/retrieve when no embed is found, but app/controllers/embed_controller.rb enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic). The test does not match the implementation so it will fail or pass for the wrong reason and provides no coverage for the actual async path, referer validation, or error cases.

findings.title: Adding column with default locks posts table
findings.body: db/migrate/20131219203905_add_cook_method_to_posts.rb:3 adds posts.cook_method with default 1 NOT NULL. On Postgres versions of this era this rewrites the entire large posts table and takes an exclusive lock, causing long downtime on production forums. It should add nullable without default, backfill, then set default/not-null.
